AUD-0043.title: CI-versus-local invocation parity and packaging/import-path exposure
AUD-0043.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: run the suite via python -m pytest from the source tree. Probe 2: pip install the built artifact into a fresh virtual environment and run the installed console script - by construction the source-tree run cannot detect a packaging or import-path regression.

AUD-0044.title: Branch-protection required-context set versus the checks that actually run
AUD-0044.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: the ruleset required_status_checks list from the API. Probe 2: the distinct check-run names reported on a recent merged PR - a required context whose name no workflow emits is permanently pending and a produced context that is not required gates nothing.

AUD-0047.title: Path-filter audit: triggers that exclude the very files the gate protects
AUD-0047.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: evaluate each filter pattern against the gate's protected file list. Probe 2: search recent real runs for a commit that touched a protected file and confirm the gate job actually ran on it - the pattern evaluation is the model and the run history is the receipt.

AUD-0053.title: Network-egress dependency census across the test suite
AUD-0053.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: run the suite with egress blocked and record every test that changes outcome. Probe 2: a socket-level trace on an unblocked run naming the destination hosts - the blocked run finds tests that DEPEND on the network and the trace finds tests that merely TOUCH it.

AUD-0055.title: Skip and xfail census with reason validity
AUD-0055.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: extract each marker with its reason and its git blame age. Probe 2: for a stratified sample, REMOVE the marker in a scratch worktree and run the test - the only way to know whether the stated reason still holds is to try it.

AUD-0057.title: Assertion-strength census: tests that never exercise the default they claim to protect
AUD-0057.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: an AST pass computing, per parameter with a default, whether any test invokes the function without supplying it. Probe 2: for the highest-risk findings, an actual value mutation of the default in a scratch worktree, requiring the suite to stay GREEN to confirm the hole.

AUD-0064.title: Monitor and cockpit surface inventory and reachability
AUD-0064.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: the dispatcher routing table enumerated statically. Probe 2: launch each route once and assert a non-empty, changing render - a pane that renders a fixed empty frame is indistinguishable from a working one on a static screenshot.

AUD-0066.title: Scheduled tasks and background services the program depends on
AUD-0066.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: the scheduled-task and service state as reported by the OS. Probe 2: an endpoint health check for each service that exposes one - a task reported as Running whose endpoint refuses connections is the finding, and the task state alone cannot show it.

AUD-0069.title: Body-level deduplication over the 283 option cards
AUD-0069.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: lexical near-duplicate detection over card bodies with planted-mutant calibration. Probe 2: an embedding-cosine rescan using the SAME planted mutants as controls, because a full rewrite lands in the same lexical band as a genuinely distinct card.

AUD-0071.title: Support-edge and independent-corroboration graph
AUD-0071.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: build support edges from explicit citation. Probe 2: collapse supports that share an upstream source into a single independent signal, then recount - the raw support count and the independent-source count are different numbers and only the second may be used for ranking.

AUD-0072.title: Confidence and verification-status normalization onto one vocabulary
AUD-0072.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: lexical mapping of each phrase to a band. Probe 2: an unmapped-residue report listing every hedge that received no band - a normalizer that maps everything has almost certainly guessed, and the residue list is the honest output.

AUD-0075.title: Stale-premise sweep over pinned ground-truth facts with mechanically different re-probes
AUD-0075.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: for each pinned fact, a re-measurement using a different shell, a different data field, or a different instrument than the one named in the pin. Probe 2: an explicit record of WHICH probe produced the original claim - an undeclared source probe means zero signals, not one, and must be reported as such.
